grading_rule: Graded against the BLS first-release CPI (headline and core YoY = NSA, MoM = SA, one decimal, exactly as the BLS news release reports them). The standing forecast updates daily as data lands; the value on the tape the evening before release is the graded call (vintage-true), consistent with the backtest methodology. Once graded, the scoreboard row is frozen — later revisions by any source never touch it.
audit_trail: Full daily as-of history for every forecaster is preserved in the engine database and surfaced on /scoreboard and /cpi-preview. This file is the dated record; sha256 is the SHA-256 of this JSON with the sha256 field removed.
